description: Incidenti stradali is a dataset listed in Comune di Bologna open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Dati relativi agli incidenti stradali nel comune di Bologna con morti e feriti, elaborazioni del Comune di Bologna su fonte ISTAT. Sono riportati i dati sintetici suddivisi per anno, numero feriti, numero morti e mezzo utilizzato. Per il rispetto della norme previste nel GDPR i dati sono aggregati per zona di prossimità. Coverage: Bologna. The portal files it under Trasporti. The portal shows 175 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-comune-bologna-it-portal.
